bossbar.title: %1$s · %2$s
event.blood_moon.name: Blood Moon
event.blood_moon.start.title: Blood Moon
event.blood_moon.start.subtitle: The monsters grow stronger...
event.blood_moon.start.chat: A Blood Moon rises. Monsters are more numerous and stronger tonight, but drop better loot.
event.blood_moon.end: The Blood Moon fades. You survived the night.
event.blood_moon.no_sleep: You cannot sleep during the Blood Moon
event.gold_rush.name: Gold Rush
event.gold_rush.start.title: Gold Rush
event.gold_rush.start.subtitle: Ores drop double!
event.gold_rush.start.chat: Gold Rush! For a few minutes, ores drop more. Grab your pickaxe.
event.meteor_shower.name: Meteor Shower
event.meteor_shower.start.title: Meteor Shower
event.meteor_shower.start.subtitle: Look up at the sky...
event.meteor_shower.start.chat: A meteor shower lights up the sky! Some meteors will fall nearby: look for their craters, they are full of ores.
mob.mimic_sack.appeared: A mimic sack is hopping nearby! Hit it before it gets away.
mob.mimic_sack.caught: The mimic sack burst into gold!
mob.living_meteorite.rises: Something is climbing out of the crater!
event.thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
event.thunderstorm.start.title: Thunderstorm
event.thunderstorm.start.subtitle: Lightning is coming down...
event.thunderstorm.start.chat: A raging thunderstorm! Lightning strikes all around, creepers get charged and storm spirits roam the sky. Defeat them to bottle their lightning.
event.thunderstorm.end: The storm passes and the sky clears.
item.bottled_lightning.fail: Aim at a block nearby to call the lightning.
command.start.busy: %s is already active here. Use /worldomens stop first.
command.start.unavailable: %s can't happen in this dimension right now (check the dimension, difficulty and game rules).
command.stop.none: No event is active in this dimension.
command.status.planned: %1$s: no event, next will be %2$s (waiting for the right moment)
command.reload.failure: Could not reload the config; keeping the previous one. Check the server log.
mob.blood_moon_lord.arrived: The Blood Moon Lord has arrived! Follow its glow.
mob.blood_moon_lord.defeated: %s has defeated the Blood Moon Lord!
mob.blood_moon_lord.retreat: The Blood Moon Lord fades away with the dawn.
item.bloody_tear.fail: The moon does not answer... (only at night, with no other event going on)
event.blessed_harvest.name: Blessed Harvest
event.blessed_harvest.start.title: Blessed Harvest
event.blessed_harvest.start.subtitle: The fields are blooming...
event.blessed_harvest.start.chat: A blessed harvest! Crops near you grow by themselves and ripe crops drop double. A harvest spirit will keep you company and leave you golden seeds.
mob.harvest_spirit.appeared: A harvest spirit has come to help with your crops.
mob.harvest_spirit.seed: The harvest spirit left you a golden seed!
item.golden_seed.fail: There are no crops here to grow.
event.merchant_caravan.name: Merchant Caravan
event.merchant_caravan.start.title: Merchant Caravan
event.merchant_caravan.start.subtitle: Rare goods are passing through...
event.merchant_caravan.start.chat: A merchant caravan is passing through! Find the nomad merchant and trade emeralds for rare goods before the caravan moves on.
event.merchant_caravan.end: The caravan packs up and moves on.
mob.nomad_merchant.arrived: A merchant caravan has set up camp near %s.
event.horde.name: Horde
event.horde.start.title: The Horde
event.horde.start.subtitle: Three waves are coming...
event.horde.start.chat: A horde is coming! Survive three waves of monsters; the Horde Warlord leads the last one.
event.horde.wave.title: Wave %s
event.horde.wave.subtitle: Here they come!
event.horde.wave.final: The Horde Warlord leads the attack!
event.horde.wave.cleared: Wave cleared! The next one is coming...
command.summon.failed: Could not summon %s there (is the area loaded?).
event.warning: Something is coming: %1$s, in about %2$s seconds.
event.ranking.seals: You earned %s event seal(s). Nomad merchants take them for relics.
event.treasure_hunt.name: Treasure Hunt
event.treasure_hunt.start.title: Treasure Hunt
event.treasure_hunt.start.subtitle: A treasure is hidden nearby...
event.treasure_hunt.start.chat: Treasure hunt! A chest full of loot lies hidden on the surface nearby. Watch the action bar to know how warm you are; the first to open it wins. Beware of whatever guards it.
event.treasure_hunt.hidden: The treasure has appeared. Follow the column of light!
event.treasure_hunt.guarded: The spectral captain keeps the chest shut.
event.treasure_hunt.free: The captain has fallen: the treasure is free!
mob.spectral_captain.arrived: The spectral captain rises to guard the treasure!
event.eruption.name: Eruption
event.eruption.start.title: Eruption
event.eruption.start.subtitle: The ground is burning...
event.eruption.start.chat: The Nether erupts! Geysers of fire burst from the ground: watch for smoke and step aside. Something huge is waking below.
mob.magma_colossus.retreat: The magma colossus sinks back into the lava.
event.void_storm.name: Void Storm
event.void_storm.start.title: Void Storm
event.void_storm.start.subtitle: The void is watching...
event.void_storm.start.chat: A void storm! Stalkers blink out of nowhere to hunt you, and pulses of the void lift you off the ground. Defeat them for their unstable pearls.
event.convergence.name: Convergence: %s
event.convergence.chat: A convergence of omens! This event lasts longer, and every point and seal counts double.
event.eclipse.name: Eclipse
event.eclipse.start.title: Eclipse
event.eclipse.start.subtitle: The sun goes dark...
event.eclipse.start.chat: The moon swallows the sun! Monsters walk in the daylight without burning and phantoms circle above. Something is watching from the dark.
event.eclipse.end: The sun returns, and the monsters of the eclipse burn.
mob.eclipse_wraith.retreat: The Eclipse Wraith fades with the returning light.
event.blizzard.name: Blizzard
event.blizzard.start.title: Blizzard
event.blizzard.start.subtitle: Find shelter from the cold
event.blizzard.start.chat: A blizzard sweeps in! Out in the snow you will freeze: stay under a roof, by a fire, or wear leather. Strays hunt in the storm, and something big is coming.
mob.frost_yeti.arrived: The Frost Yeti roars somewhere in the storm!
mob.frost_yeti.retreat: The Frost Yeti vanishes into the snow.
event.firefly_night.name: Firefly Night
event.firefly_night.start.title: Firefly Night
event.firefly_night.start.subtitle: Follow the lights under the stars
event.firefly_night.start.chat: Lights are glowing nearby. Head outdoors and follow the direction and distance hints: approach each light to earn experience and points. No catching or special items needed.
event.firefly_night.end: The fireflies fade until another night.
command.help.none: No event is active in this dimension. Use /worldomens help <id>.
command.help.title: Help: %s
command.help.blood_moon.objective: Survive the night and defeat empowered monsters.
command.help.blood_moon.reward: Extra loot and experience; points for combat.
command.help.blood_moon.conditions: Overworld at night; ends at dawn.
command.help.gold_rush.reward: More ore and a chance of lucky nuggets.
command.help.thunderstorm.objective: Dodge lightning and defeat storm spirits.
command.help.blessed_harvest.objective: Harvest ripe crops and follow the spirits.
command.help.merchant_caravan.objective: Find the merchant and trade. Use /worldomens contract to see material deliveries for seals.
command.help.merchant_caravan.reward: Rare items for emeralds and seals; earn up to two seals from contracts during the caravan.
command.help.merchant_caravan.conditions: Overworld in daytime; needs open space.
command.help.horde.objective: Survive three waves and defeat the warlord.
command.help.horde.reward: Experience, points and a possible axe.
command.help.horde.conditions: Overworld at night; ends at dawn.
command.help.treasure_hunt.objective: Follow distance hints and defeat the captain.
command.help.treasure_hunt.reward: Chest treasure and points for the finder.
command.help.treasure_hunt.conditions: Overworld in daytime; the guardian locks the chest.
command.help.eruption.objective: Dodge geysers and defeat the colossus.
command.help.eruption.reward: Magma heart and a possible hammer.
command.help.eclipse.objective: Survive the shadows and defeat wraiths.
command.help.blizzard.objective: Survive the cold and defeat the yeti.
command.help.firefly_night.conditions: Overworld at night; ends at dawn.
command.contract.header: Caravan contracts: %s deliveries left. Approach the merchant and use /worldomens contract <id>.
command.contract.iron: iron: 12 iron ingots for 1 event seal
command.contract.rotten_flesh: rotten_flesh: 64 rotten flesh for 1 event seal
command.contract.no_event: You need an active caravan and must be in survival mode.
command.contract.too_far: Move within 8 blocks of a caravan merchant.
command.contract.limit: You already completed two contracts in this caravan.
command.contract.not_enough: You do not have enough materials for that contract.
command.contract.unknown: Unknown contract. Use /worldomens encargo to see options.
command.ranking.no_event: No event is active in this dimension.
command.ranking.empty: No one has earned points yet.
event.piglin_warband.name: Piglin Warband
event.piglin_warband.start.title: Piglin Warband
event.piglin_warband.start.subtitle: War drums echo through the Nether...
event.piglin_warband.start.chat: A piglin warband marches on you! Survive three waves; the Piglin Warchief leads the last one. Golden armor calms the piglins, but not the brutes or the Warchief.
event.piglin_warband.end: The warband withdraws into the dark.
event.piglin_warband.wave.title: Wave %s
event.piglin_warband.wave.subtitle: They are coming for your gold!
event.piglin_warband.wave.final: The Piglin Warchief joins the attack!
event.piglin_warband.wave.cleared: Wave cleared! The next one is coming...
event.drowned_tide.name: Tide of the Drowned
event.drowned_tide.start.title: Tide of the Drowned
event.drowned_tide.start.subtitle: The sea gives up its dead...
event.drowned_tide.start.chat: The tide is rising and the drowned are coming ashore! Survive three waves; the Tidecaller leads the last one. Stay away from the water's edge.
event.drowned_tide.end: The tide goes out and the drowned sink back under.
event.drowned_tide.wave.title: Wave %s
event.drowned_tide.wave.subtitle: They rise from the water!
event.drowned_tide.wave.final: The Tidecaller rises from the deep!
event.drowned_tide.wave.cleared: Wave cleared! The next one is coming...
event.drowned_tide.victory: The tide has been turned back!
event.fishing_festival.name: Fishing Festival
event.fishing_festival.start.title: Fishing Festival
event.fishing_festival.start.subtitle: The fish are biting today
event.fishing_festival.start.chat: The Fishing Festival has begun! Grab a rod and fish near water: you get Luck, experience and points for every catch.
command.help.piglin_warband.objective: Survive three waves and defeat the Warchief.
command.help.piglin_warband.reward: Experience, points, gold and a possible cleaver.
command.help.piglin_warband.conditions: Nether only; golden armor calms piglins but not brutes.
command.help.drowned_tide.objective: Hold the shore through three waves and defeat the Tidecaller.
command.help.drowned_tide.reward: Experience, points, prismarine and a possible conch.
command.help.drowned_tide.conditions: Overworld at night near water; ends at dawn.
command.help.fishing_festival.objective: Fish as much as you can.
command.help.fishing_festival.reward: Luck while it lasts, experience, points and an advancement.
command.help.fishing_festival.conditions: Overworld in daytime with water nearby.
command.preset.unknown: Unknown preset: %s. Use calm, normal or epic.
